Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How important was Haig’s leadership in determining the outcome of the Battle of the Somme?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the work of women in ensuring that Britain’s ‘Home Front’ could cope with the
demands of war? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How important was the Great Depression as a reason for Nazi electoral success, 1930–33?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was economic recovery as a reason for the lack of effective opposition to Nazi
rule, 1933–39? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How important was the October Manifesto in the survival of the Tsar’s regime between 1905 and
1914? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were Lenin’s April Theses as a reason for Bolshevik success by November 1917?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How significant was the motor car as a cause of changes in US society in the 1920s? Explain your
answer. [40]
How important was Hoover as a reason for Roosevelt’s success in the 1932 Presidential election?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was the Cultural Revolution in enabling Mao to establish a personal dictatorship in
China? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was social reform in changing China in the 1950s? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How significant was Steve Biko in changing the nature of resistance to apartheid? Explain your
answer. [40]
How important were economic problems as a reason for the end of minority rule in South Africa?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the Suez War of 1956 as a cause of the Six-Day War of 1967? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the expulsion of the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) from Jordan in
1970 in determining the relations between the PLO and Arab states? Explain your answer. [40]
